title: [epic] IMAP4rev2 (RFC 9051) support
description:
Implement IMAP4rev2 (RFC 9051) alongside the existing IMAP4rev1 server. RFC 9051 absorbs many extensions as mandatory baseline (IDLE, MOVE, UNSELECT, ENABLE, LITERAL+, SPECIAL-USE, LIST-EXTENDED, etc.) which are already implemented. The remaining work is the IMAP4rev2-specific additions: NAMESPACE, STATUS=SIZE, SASL-IR, FETCH SAVEDATE, and per-session RFC 9051 mode via ENABLE IMAP4rev2.

Implementation approach: use Capability::Other(CapabilityOther) to advertise IMAP4REV2 in the CAPABILITY response today — no upstream imap-types change needed. When imap-types ships Capability::Imap4Rev2 (tracked in duesee/imap-codec#702), swap the one line. Session mode is a per-connection bool; ENABLE IMAP4rev2 handling requires no library support.
